transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you, too. I guess I'm here because... well, most days I wake up and it already feels like there's this heavy, gray weight sitting on me. 

And it just stays there. Even when I'm out working with the landscaping crew, or at home around my kids, I can't seem to shake it. It's just this constant low, hollow feeling. It really just feels like I'm going through the motions every day.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, gray low mood?

It's been a long time. Um... I'd say it's been going on for about three years and three months now. It started right around the time our groundskeeping contract changed at work. They changed our schedule, and the longer days just kind of... took over my life. I've felt this way ever since.
During the past two years, have there been any periods longer than two months when you did not feel this low mood?
No... no, I haven't. It hasn't really let up at all. I don't think I've had even a good week where I felt normal, let alone two whole months. It's just always there.
If your work schedule had never changed, do you think you still would have felt this same low mood?

I... honestly, I'm not really sure. It's hard to say. The schedule change was definitely rough, but... maybe I would have ended up feeling this way anyway. I just don't know. It's been so long now that it's hard to even picture how things would have gone if that hadn't happened.
Do you often feel hopeless?

Yeah, I do. I just keep telling myself that this is just how my life is now. It feels like... well, no matter how hard I work or try to get back to the things I used to do, you know, like working in my own garden or going to those music nights... nothing is really going to turn around. It just is what it is.
During this time, have there ever been at least two weeks when your depression became noticeably worse than your usual baseline?

No, I don't think so. It's pretty much just stayed the exact same level of bad the whole time. I haven't really noticed a point where it suddenly dropped and got a lot worse for a couple of weeks... it's just a steady, heavy feeling every single day.
Do you often feel badly about yourself?

No, not really. I mean, I don't think I'm a bad person or anything. I don't hate myself. It's more just... I'm tired all the time, and I don't care about much anymore. But I don't sit around beating myself up over it. It's just... this is just how I am now, I guess.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really get nervous or... keyed up about things. It's not like I'm sitting around worrying. I don't really even have the energy to be on edge, to be honest. It's just that heavy, tired feeling all the time, not an anxious one.
Do you often feel low on energy or tired?

Yeah, pretty much all the time. Honestly, by midmorning, my body already feels like I've put in a full day. And it doesn't seem to matter if I rest... even after sleeping in on a Sunday, I still just drag through the simplest things. Just loading up my tools, checking the job plans for work, or even just making dinner at night... it all just takes so much effort. I'm just constantly drained.
Do you often have trouble concentrating or making decisions?

No, not really. I mean, my brain feels a little foggy sometimes just because I'm so tired, but I don't have trouble focusing on what I need to do. When I'm at work, I know what needs to get done and I just do it. I can still plan out the jobs and figure out what materials we need. I don't really sit around second-guessing myself or anything.
Have you often had a poor appetite or overeaten during this time?
No, my appetite is pretty normal. I eat about the same amount I always have. I haven't noticed myself skipping meals or eating more than usual. Food just... is what it is. I eat when I need to.
During this time, have you often had trouble sleeping, or slept much more than usual?

No, my sleep is pretty normal. I don't have a hard time falling asleep or anything like that. And I'm not sleeping all day either. I just get my regular seven or eight hours, wake up when my alarm goes off, and get ready for work. Sleep hasn't really been an issue for me.
During this time, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still like doing my usual stuff. I mean, I still watch the game on Sundays, work on my truck a bit when I have the time... I haven't stopped liking those things. I still get enjoyment out of them, same as always.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable for several days in a row?

No, I've never had anything like that. I've never felt unusually high or energetic, or had days where I was just irritable for no reason. I don't really get those kinds of mood swings. Things are just pretty steady, I guess. I just go to work, do my job, come home. I don't have periods where I'm wired or anything.
